lines.beaver_en: Hello! Is it foggy outside today?
lines.en: Yes, it was very foggy this morning.
It's two below zero. It's really cold.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, below zero? Are the roads frozen?
lines.en: Yes, the road is frozen. There's ice.

lines.beaver_en: I'd better be careful. Is the sun up?
lines.en: The sun is up. But it's very cloudy.

lines.beaver_en: Will it get warmer during the day?
lines.en: No, it'll only be 5 degrees even during the day.

lines.beaver_en: How are the autumn leaves? Still pretty?
lines.en: The autumn leaves have almost all fallen.

lines.beaver_en: What a pity. Can you see any in the park?
lines.learner: 공원에 빨간 나무가 한 그루밖에 없어요.
lines.en: There's only one red tree in the park.
lines.roman: gongwone ppalgan namuga han geurubakke eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The weather was really strange this year, wasn't it?
lines.en: Right. The rainy season was long this summer.

lines.beaver_en: Right. It really rained a lot.
lines.learner: 요즘은 해가 빨리 져요. 다섯 시에 져요.
lines.en: These days the sun sets early. It sets at five.
lines.roman: yojeumeun haega ppalli jyeoyo. daseot sie jyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then it'll be colder in the evening. Thanks!
lines.en: Yes, be sure to dress warmly when you go out.
